title: Musher Listing Document
description: The catalog storefront entry for a blueprint or component.
$comment: Seeded from the platform's generated catalog schema. Structural and type validation only — cross-document reference resolution, slug/directory agreement, and platform capability checks are separate validation layers. See spec.md.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Document kind discriminator. Must be LISTING.

specVersion.title: Specversion
specVersion.description: Version of the seed authoring document format.

SeedItemMetadata.title: SeedItemMetadata
SeedItemMetadata.description: Identity block shared by the blueprint + listing documents.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Item slug — must equal the item's directory name.

version.title: Version
version.description: Item version — must agree between blueprint.yaml and listing.yaml.

SeedListingFeatured.title: SeedListingFeatured
SeedListingFeatured.description: Featured-flag declaration on a seeded listing.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: True to promote the listing on the featured storefront row.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Ordering weight among featured listings; lower sorts first.

SeedListingScreenshot.title: SeedListingScreenshot
SeedListingScreenshot.description: One storefront screenshot declared as a relative media path.

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: Accessible caption shown beneath the screenshot, or null when none.

file.title: File
file.description: Relative path of the screenshot asset under the item's media/ directory.

SeedListingSpec.title: SeedListingSpec
SeedListingSpec.description:
The ``spec`` block of a listing document.

Mirrors the backstage ``CatalogListingDraftRequest`` field names minus
server-side identity (``slug``/``version`` live in ``metadata``;
``blueprintId``/``blueprintVersion`` are derived; ``parentListingId`` is
n/a). Deviations: ``icon`` + ``screenshots[].file`` are relative media
paths (not Files-BC ids), and ``featured`` is seed-only. Drift-gated in
``tests/unit/seeds/test_catalog_manifest_drift.py``.

description.title: Description
description.description: Long-form Markdown storefront description, or null when none.

category.title: Category
category.description: Storefront category the listing is browsed under.

displayName.title: Displayname
displayName.description: Storefront title shown to prospective installers.

featured.description: Featured-row placement; defaults to not featured.

homepageUrl.title: Homepageurl
homepageUrl.description: Project homepage URL, or null when none.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Relative path of the listing's icon under the item's media/ directory (e.g. media/icon.png), or null for no icon.

license.title: License
license.description: License identifier for the listed software, or null when unspecified.

lifecycleStage.title: Lifecyclestage
lifecycleStage.description: Maturity stage shown on the storefront: STABLE, BETA, EXPERIMENTAL, or SUNSET.

listingKind.title: Listingkind
listingKind.description: Storefront classification (ADR 0071, amended by ADR 0112): BLUEPRINT (curated composition) or COMPONENT (single building block).

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.description: Storefront screenshots in display order, declared as media paths.

sourceRepoUrl.title: Sourcerepourl
sourceRepoUrl.description: Source repository URL, or null when none.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One-line storefront tagline summarising the listing.

supportUrl.title: Supporturl
supportUrl.description: Support or documentation URL, or null when none.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Free-form discovery tags applied to the listing.
